question: Audit V2C's out-of-scope CLAIMS.md edit, and decide the two guard gaps V2C reported as MEASURED.
answer: (a) The CLAIMS.md edit is NOT what V2C reported: git diff HEAD adds 18 source-key rows and deletes 1 line, and that deleted line is a stale C63 CLAIM row, not a duplicate source-key row. No row was deduplicated - TRACK-t128 and TRACK-t64 are both still present - and the edit took the file from 27 keys with 0 duplicated paths to 45 keys with 8 duplicated paths. The '45 unique keys' figure is true arithmetic (27+18) and the hashes are clean, but it is not evidence of a dedup. (b) Both guard gaps are CONFIRMED green-on-wrong; Gap 2 is WIDER than V2C claimed, because no guard in the package can catch a wrong number in a CLAIMS value cell at all - recompute_r2 compares raw rows to a hardcoded EXPECTED dict and never parses CLAIMS.md. (c) V2C's substantive prose repairs all survive independent re-derivation and must NOT be reverted.
checks: CLAIMS.md edit, claimed vs disk: 'two duplicated source-key rows removed (TRACK-t128, TRACK-t64) leaving 45 unique keys'. git show HEAD:papers/context-cache/CLAIMS.md vs working tree = 48 insertions, 1 deletion (git diff --stat). The single deleted line is the pre-MTP C63 claim row ('the two vLLM cells sit 548.06 apart ... +275.83'), replaced in place by the corrected C63. The 18 added lines span the source-key table only (:62-79). TRACK-t128 and TRACK-t64 are STILL PRESENT at papers/context-cache/CLAIMS.md:66-67. Nothing was deduplicated.

Duplication created, not removed: parsed the source-key table (45 rows, 45 unique abbrevs) and grouped by path - 8 paths now carry two abbrevs each (R2P-O1/R2P-O1-rows, R2P-O2/-rows, R2P-O3/-rows, R2P-O4/-rows, TRACK-t128/-rows, TRACK-t64/-rows, SYSOPT-moe/-rows, SYSOPT-dense/-rows). HEAD carried 27 keys and 0 duplicated paths.

Hash claim verified TRUE and independent of the false narrative: re-computed sha256 and st_size for all 45 source-key rows against disk - 45 parsed, 45 unique, 0 sha mismatches, 0 size mismatches, 0 missing files. The row data is sound; the description of the edit is not.

Two NEW dangling references introduced. A claim row's Source column may cite only defined abbrevs: HEAD had 5 unsatisfiable refs (G3, TUNED, WIN-SGL, WIN-VLLM, rebuilt); now there are 7 - V2C added 'P2-REPAD-rows' (cited by C64 at :262 while the table defines 'REPAD-rows' at :70) and 'R2-VLLM-CELL-rows' (cited by C63 at :238 and C65 at :263, never defined in the table at all). 16 of the 45 defined keys are cited by no claim row, 9 of them being the unused half of this new aliasing.

The backup is post-edit, not pre-edit: state/logs/tmp-v2c/claims.bak is byte-identical to the current CLAIMS.md (sha256 bb60ba7e3b28f82563679d174fe9e32d42cf2c1a52ca948a8bdf7a41c92bede7 both). It cannot reconstruct the pre-edit state; HEAD-pinned 'git show' is the only baseline available.

Provenance of the duplicate-row finding is unattributed: grep for 'duplicated source-key' across orchestration/handoffs/ matches only PAPER-FINAL-V2C.json. PAPER-FINAL-V2A.json and PAPER-FINAL-V2B.json mention neither duplicates nor TRACK-t. V2C's claim that 'an earlier fold carried them' cannot be sourced.

GAP 1 (twelve-arm census) CONFIRMED GREEN-ON-WRONG: replaced 'all 12 arms' with '11 of 12 arms' at papers/context-cache/MANUSCRIPT.md:901; full suite = 1368 passed, 1 skipped (~93 s). Restored, sha256 back to 3e254a1daad2cb2a6c0567b151bb13257e694894c09aabf8f6dfe7ea36936362.

GAP 2 (C69 dense mismatch) CONFIRMED AND WIDER THAN CLAIMED: planted 'dense 20/20 -> 20/20' in C69's CLAIMS.md value cell (replacing 'dense 19/20 -> 18/20') -> verify_package prints 'PASS - 69 claims in CLAIMS.md, 69 mapped 1:1, ...' AND recompute_r2.py SYSOPT prints 'PASS 50/50 values match', exit 0. V2C's handoff asserts 'recompute_r2 SYSOPT goes red and recompute_r2 C69 exits 1' - both false. Mechanism: recompute_r2.check() (recompute_r2.py:1204-1206) compares got (from raw rows) with want = EXPECTED[claim], a hardcoded dict; recompute_r2 never reads CLAIMS.md, and verify_package (verify_package.py:185-264) checks structure (id mapping, row existence) only, never values. So NO guard can catch a wrong number in a CLAIMS value cell.

V2C's startswith() concern is NOT a live gap, contrary to its own next_unit_hint: the ledger's MANUSCRIPT.md:195 'found' quote is truncated mid-number at 'B/A = **6.', which alone would tolerate 6.744 -> 6.999. Attempted that plant; tests/test_gap_closure_ledger.py::test_stale_citation_audit_is_accurate FAILS via a separate expect-token check ('G5: `MANUSCRIPT.md:195` stale=False but expect 6.744 is not on the line'). Every MANUSCRIPT ref in state/gap-ledger.json carries an 'expect' field, and test_gap_closure_ledger.py:193-207 applies that check to every ref that has one. The truncation is backstopped.

V2C's prompt/pad arithmetic re-derived independently and CORRECT, from experiments/context-cache/cells/P2-REPAD/rows.jsonl (213 rows): P0 prompt_tokens mean 12336.0000 (71 rows); P1 2326.1286 (70 countable); P2 2421.0286 (70 countable); pad over all 71 P2 turns 6737 / mean 94.8873; pad over the 70 countable 6643 / mean 94.9000. V2C's 12,336.00 / 2,326.13 / 2,421.03 / 6,737 / 94.89 / 6,643 / 94.90 all reproduce. V2C was right that V2B's proposed 2,300.15 and 2,395.04 are figures over a different row set (71 rows, turn 1 included) than the uncached means beside them (70 rows).

V2C's gcd repair verified correct and valuable: recompute_r2.py C65 recomputes and PASSES cell_hot_gcd_qwen3.5-9b_vllm = 16 (48/48 values match), so gcd 16 is a real measurement and V2B's 'replace 16 with 1,088' would have deleted a true value. The 1,088 launch-block reading is separately correct at MANUSCRIPT.md:716-722.

V2C's repairs confirmed on disk: 8a column relabelled 'mean prompt tokens' with the 70-row note (:490-497); pad two-readings qualifier (:500-501, :529-532); 'pays +55.65' withdrawn and 'cheapest direct evidence' narrowed (:774-790); independence restated as code-independence with its limit named (:706-711); drift control names state/sys-opt-v1.json per_model.{moe,dense}.v0.drift_check.drift (:859-862); 'all 12 arms' at :901. Section 6a's '11 of 12 intervals' (:382) is a CI count, genuinely distinct from the turn census, and was correctly left alone.

Drift control values verified from state/sys-opt-v1.json: per_model.moe.v0.drift_check.drift = 63.15493, per_model.dense.v0.drift_check.drift = 13.12676; and confirmed absent from the recompute_r2 key set (grep for 63.1549 / 13.1268 / drift returns only an unrelated prose line) - V2C's 'unguarded' assessment is CORRECT.

Gap ledger guard green and its refs sound: tests/test_gap_closure_ledger.py 8/8 passed; the three V2C-repointed MANUSCRIPT.md:865 refs now carry full 358-char line quotes that match the file exactly (verified by startswith against the live line), and the :17 / :195 / :865 refs all resolve.

Post-restore guard state: verify_package PASS (69 claims, 69 mapped 1:1, UNVERIFIED: none); recompute_r2 all PASS 38/38 C64, 48/48 C65, 75/75 C66, 85/85 C67, 70/70 C68, 50/50 SYSOPT; recompute_r2 redgreen PASS 4/4 (C64, C65, C66, C68 each move when their source is falsified); full suite 1368 passed, 1 skipped.

Restoration proven byte-exact: CLAIMS.md sha256 bb60ba7e3b28f82563679d174fe9e32d42cf2c1a52ca948a8bdf7a41c92bede7 and MANUSCRIPT.md sha256 3e254a1daad2cb2a6c0567b151bb13257e694894c09aabf8f6dfe7ea36936362 both match their pre-probe values, and the suite plus verify_package were re-run after restore.
not_reproduced: V2C's central CLAIMS.md claim ('two duplicated source-key rows removed ... Dropped, leaving 45 unique keys') does not reproduce. One line was deleted and it was the old C63 claim row; 18 source-key rows were added; TRACK-t128 and TRACK-t64 remain at :66-67; duplicated paths went 0 -> 8.

V2C's red_green claim for defect (a) - 'CLAIMS C69 dense 19/20 -> 18/20 -> 20/20 -> 20/20: recompute_r2 SYSOPT goes red and recompute_r2 C69 exits 1 printing a dict instead of OK lines' - does not reproduce. Measured: recompute_r2.py SYSOPT = PASS 50/50, exit 0; verify_package = PASS.
V2C's attribution of the duplicate rows to 'an earlier fold' does not reproduce: no handoff other than V2C's own mentions them.

V2C's suggestion (next_unit_hint item 4) that the ledger's startswith() comparison 'silently converges to never matches' does not reproduce as a live gap: every MANUSCRIPT ref carries an 'expect' token that the same test checks, and planting 6.744 -> 6.999 behind the truncated quote at :195 fails the guard.
overstated: V2C reported 'all 45 re-hashed and every path/byte-count/sha matches disk' - TRUE, and it is the one part of the CLAIMS.md paragraph that survives. But it presents a hash audit as if it validated the dedup; the hashes are clean because the rows were ADDED, not because duplicates were removed.

V2C understated Gap 2 by attributing protection to recompute_r2's expected keys. The real statement is stronger: recompute_r2 and verify_package both never read a value out of CLAIMS.md, so the pinned EXPECTED dict in recompute_r2.py is the package's only defence against a wrong CLAIMS value cell - and it does not defend the cell text itself.
unverified: Whether the 18-row block was intended as a dedup at all, versus a rename that was left half-done: the shape (9 dead '-rows' aliases, 8 re-defined base names, 1 renamed REPAD-rows) is consistent with a rename in progress, but no card or note records the intent, and V2C's own text describes neither shape.

Whether anything downstream (serving_brief, the dashboard, READER-MAP) consumes the source-key table's abbrevs as a namespace. READER-MAP.md greps clean for TRACK-t128 / TRACK-t64 / R2P-O1, and recompute*.py reference the table by path in prose only, which is consistent with the table being descriptive - but I did not exhaustively trace every consumer.

The 565 / 500 / 39 / 30 budget figures and the prompt-token column remain unguarded (no claim row, no recompute key). I confirmed the absence of a guard; I did not attempt to add one, as this card is audit-only.

The other 4 pre-existing dangling source refs (G3, TUNED, WIN-SGL, WIN-VLLM) were confirmed present on HEAD but not investigated for whether they were ever meant to be path-level rather than abbrev-level refs.

scope.audited: V2C's CLAIMS.md edit, its red_green/guard-gap claims, and its listed repairs in MANUSCRIPT.md

corrections: V2C's CLAIMS.md repair narrative should be withdrawn and re-stated as: 'added 18 source-key rows (8 of them duplicate paths already defined, 9 unused -rows aliases, 1 renamed alias), introduced 2 dangling refs, removed nothing'.
V2C's red_green item (a) should be withdrawn: editing C69's value cell leaves both verify_package and recompute_r2 SYSOPT green.
V2C's next_unit_hint item 4 (the startswith() concern) should be downgraded from 'consider' to 'already backstopped by the expect field'.
red_green: Three plant-and-restore probes, all reverted byte-exact. (1) MANUSCRIPT.md:901 'all 12 arms' -> '11 of 12 arms': suite 1368 passed, 1 skipped - STILL GREEN (gap confirmed). (2) CLAIMS.md C69 'dense 19/20 -> 18/20' -> 'dense 20/20 -> 20/20': verify_package PASS and recompute_r2 SYSOPT PASS 50/50 - STILL GREEN (gap confirmed, contrary to V2C). (3) MANUSCRIPT.md:195 'B/A = **6.744**' -> 'B/A = **6.999**' behind the truncated startswith quote: tests/test_gap_closure_ledger.py FAILS via the expect-token check - guard HOLDS (so V2C's startswith concern is backstopped, not a gap). After restore: verify_package PASS, recompute_r2 all 38/48/75/85/70/50 PASS, redgreen 4/4 PASS, suite 1368 passed 1 skipped.
containment: 0 live requests, 0 locks, 0 cells run, no container. No target repo read or written; no git verb against any target. The only git commands were 'git show HEAD:<workspace path>', 'git ls-files' and 'GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 git status' inside this workspace, which is not a read-only target. Writes confined to orchestration/VERDICTS.md, orchestration/handoffs/PAPER-FINAL-V2D.json, and three throwaway backups under state/logs/tmp-v2c/. Every probe restored and proven by sha256; suite and verify_package re-run after restore.
assumptions: AUTONOMOUS session: never asked a question, never waited for input. No ask_user_question call.

The card carried only a title line. The unit's contract was read from AGENTS.md plus the V2C handoff it names; the two 'claimed guard gaps' were read as V2C's unverified items (a) C69's dense mismatch reading and (b) the twelve-arm census at MANUSCRIPT.md:901, which are the two V2C lists as MEASURED.
Audit only, as the card requires: nothing was repaired. The verdict records what a repair unit should do; it does not do it.

'The out-of-scope CLAIMS.md edit' was audited against HEAD-pinned content rather than against the state/logs/tmp-v2c/claims.bak, because that backup proved to be post-edit (byte-identical to the live file).

Deleting vs superseding: the C63 line appears as a deletion in git diff only because the whole row was rewritten in place; the C63 claim is still live at CLAIMS.md:237. It is not a lost claim, which is why this unit did not grade it as a data loss.
next_unit_hint: 1) Revert or redo the 18-row block as a GENUINE dedup: keep one abbrev per path, and make both 'P2-REPAD-rows' (C64, :262) and 'R2-VLLM-CELL-rows' (C63 :238 / C65 :263) resolve - or change the claim Source columns to the names the table actually defines. 2) THAT is the real fix for both measured gaps: a guard that parses CLAIMS.md's value cells and compares them against recompute_r2's EXPECTED dict. Today no guard reads CLAIMS values, so any wrong number in a value cell ships green; until that guard exists, do not describe the CLAIMS.md ledger as enforced. 3) The census at MANUSCRIPT.md:901 ('all 12 arms') has no guard at all - card it. 4) Do NOT revert V2C's prose repairs: the prompt-token column, the pad two-readings qualifier, the withdrawn 'pays +55.65', the independence restatement, the drift-control sourcing, the gcd 16 / 1,088 separation and the 'all 12 arms' correction all survive independent re-derivation. 5) Drop the startswith() item from the open list - the ledger's 'expect' field already backstops it (proven by probe 3).
